⌊
DRAFT
g
Confidential information protection
⌈
The
VehiclePackageManagement
and
VehicleDriverApplication
interfaces shall
only be called over secure communication channel providing confidentiality protection.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00033)
The
GetSwClusterInfo
,
SwPackageInventory
,
GetCampaignHistory
,
GetSwClusterChangeInfo
,
GetHistory
,
GetSwClusterDescription
and
GetSwPackages
methods are using data that could identify vehicle user and there-
fore should be protected for confidentiality.
